description: Search the Swiss Classified Compilation (SR/RS) of federal law by title or abbreviation (e.g. 'data protection', 'OR', 'Datenschutz'). Exact abbreviation/title matches are ranked first. Returns SR number, title, abbreviation and the official Fedlex link. Search in the language of your query term (German titles for German terms, etc.).
name: search_federal_law
title: Search federal legislation
